Implementation:
- Separate frozen exact startup predicate STRATA_PREFILL_GATED_ALIAS=1, default OFF; absent, 0, 01, true and other values remain OFF. Exact gated opt-in requires frozen existing STRATA_PREFILL_SCRATCH_ALIAS=1; init rejects missing dependency and out-of-order compute before any allocation. Count rejects missing scratch dependency. Positive chunk and gate extent multiplication/rounding are checked before allocation when enabled. No GPU identity hardcode.
- Remove only the normal full-chunk FP32 m.gated logical take when enabled. Both HC halves retain producer up GEMM -> injection GEMM (separate inj/xn16) -> full read gr_mix_r -> first shared GDN/QSA/MoE scratch writer, on the same in-order cs used by Gemm/oneMath/native kernels. m.gated has no later normal-path reader. R, xn16, injection and residual writes remain separate. No launch/math/dtype/precision/cache/session changes.
- Production region_layout computes block_max from actual GDN/QSA/MoE requested set extents, gate_extent using exact Alloc rounding, region_extent=max(block_max,gate_extent) for alias ON, and actual outer region allocation requested bytes. Correctly reports gated as region winner if gate exceeds the block maximum. OFF retains the separate gate take and original shared allocation.
- Alloc::take itself uses host-only take_bytes/advance, preserving original rounding (elements*sizeof+511)&~255 and successful/failure cursor behavior. Count, owned and borrowed therefore share these primitives. Count and carve both invoke region_layout; relayout invokes carve with the same frozen flag. gate_view is shared production code for the bounded alias pointer and is exercised by the host fixture. Failed shared backing allocation returns before any nested views could accidentally create owned allocations.
- m.region_bytes retains original block_max for PLE/draft local scratch and batch-size decisions, even if gated enlarges backing. Their local gate variables/views remain untouched. Normal block views have the actual larger region capacity. This preserves existing PLE/draft batching rather than treating extra gate-only extent as new batching capacity.
- STRATA_TRACE with scratch alias ON prints a new gated line for either gated arm: enabled, T, borrowed, total requested ledger, block_max/block_winner, gate_extent, region_extent, allocated_region requested bytes, region_winner, saved_requested, actual gate/region pointers and pointer_equal. Existing scratch trace remains a block-only view. phase_capacity_estimate already calls bytes_needed and therefore receives the alias-adjusted workspace count without separate estimate arithmetic.
- Existing 12K phase startup conjunction (head lease plus scratch alias), positive existing operator reserve (default700MiB), and no automatic capacity/reserve reduction are untouched. Gated remains optional for explicit A/B.

Source count, NOT physical/speed evidence:
Stock T=12288, D=10240 has raw gated payload503316480B. Alloc gate extent503316736B (480MiB+256). When block_max exceeds gate extent, removing the separate gate take saves exactly503316736 requested bytes; outer shared rounding is unchanged. For gate>block_max, helper enlarges backing and derives savings as gate_extent - (new_allocated_region - old_allocated_region), not unconditional480MiB. It avoids overflowing the hypothetical old gate+region sum. region/product/take/cursor overflows reject. This is a narrow alias accounting helper, not a generalized audit of inherited geometry expressions in every GDN/QSA/MoE set calculator.

Added fixture (NOT RUN): existing phase_cache_owner_test includes host-only workspace helper, no SYCL headers or new CMake target. Synthetic G<B/G=B/G>B and ON/OFF cover production layout/max/winner/padding; count-only and fake owned requested receipts vs exact-capacity borrowed cursor agreement; 256-byte alignment/pointer offsets; production gate_view identity/bounded range; smaller-cap failure with unchanged cursor; shrink/regrow extents; stock12K corrected503316736 savings; exact flag parsing; gate view rejection without required enlargement; multiply/aligned-take/outer-region/cumulative overflow. Fake owned receipts validate helper accounting, not GPU allocation or the full Prefill owned/free lifecycle. Synthetic fixtures are not numerical or queue-order proofs.
